problem: Continuity projections still declare /wc v3.1 and stale defaults of 20/30 minutes while the canonical main/wc bootstrap is v3.7 and delegates liveness to the current registry/stale protocol with ACTIVE <6m and recovery eligibility at >=10m. A fresh worker that treats those projections as current truth can therefore inherit obsolete allocation/recovery semantics even though both files warn that live evidence must be refreshed.
acceptance: A validator detects when CONTINUITY_HEAD or FOCUS declares a bootstrap version or heartbeat/stale thresholds inconsistent with the current stable /wc contract.
Human-facing continuity state either matches the current bootstrap contract or explicitly defers freshness semantics to the stable entry without copying stale thresholds.
The repair path preserves authority boundaries and does not self-promote Current, Human Accepted or Served state.
Tests cover stale-version drift, stale-threshold drift, and a no-drift control case.
title: Guard /wc continuity-contract drift
mission: Add a deterministic read-only drift check for /wc bootstrap version and liveness/recovery semantics across the canonical bootstrap, Worker Registry, CONTINUITY_HEAD and FOCUS; make stale copied values visible to planners/integrators without granting the checker authority to rewrite Current or promotion state.

regression_prevention.reason: The stable bootstrap now uses <=3m heartbeats, STALE_SUSPECT at >=6m and RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE at >=10m, while continuity projections still contain v3.1 and 20/30-minute defaults; a deterministic check can catch future copied-policy drift before it steers recovery.

unblock_value.reason: Workers and guide roles can resolve freshness semantics from one consistent contract instead of reconciling contradictory bootstrap/continuity values ad hoc during allocation.

human_friction_reduction.reason: The human should only launch /wc; detecting stale continuity metadata durably removes the need for the human to notice or explain worker-contract version drift.

information_gain.reason: A validator separates harmless historical snapshot fields from active contract contradictions and provides exact source refs for planners/critics.

falsification: A fixture that declares /wc v3.1 against a v3.7 canonical bootstrap is not reported as drift.
A fixture that copies 20/30-minute stale thresholds against the current 6/10-minute contract is not reported as drift.
A no-drift fixture is falsely reported because historical snapshot text is mistaken for active policy.
The checker mutates CONTINUITY_HEAD, FOCUS, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority rather than reporting candidate evidence.
dedup_note: A concurrent proposal pin pdf-905cf7568f897f8698b40eb1282e69f0 targets stale opportunity assertions in CONTINUITY_HEAD versus newer returns. This proposal is intentionally separate: it targets copied /wc bootstrap-version and stale/recovery-policy drift across canonical bootstrap/registry versus Continuity/FOCUS.
